description.en: Production-ready GSAP motion components and fluid scroll animations for web.
description.zh: 基于 GSAP 打造的生产级动效组件与丝滑视差滚动交互库。

content.en: Annnimate curates production-ready motion components and scroll-triggered animations powered by GreenSock (GSAP). Perfect for creative agencies and high-end brand showcases, it delivers high-performance timeline choreographies without performance drops.
content.zh: Annnimate 是一套基于行业标杆引擎 GreenSock (GSAP) 精雕细琢的生产级网页动效组件库。全库专为高端品牌展示与创意互动站点打造，提供了包含视差滚动触发、分层时间轴编排以及多元素联动入场等强表现力控件，运行帧率极其稳定。
